notes.title: Wigmund - Patch 1.4.4
notes.notes:
In this patch we have improved and fixed the following:

[b][b]Misc:[/b][/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the size of flying enemies for better hit response
[*]Decreased medicine level required to pick Licorice and Meadowsweet
[*]Craft up to 5 recipes at a time
[*]Improved tooltip item comparison
[*]Fixed an input action queue issue
[/list]

[b]Action queue disable:[/b] We have found a certain issue related to the action queue, that is, if two actions like a roll and a stab are executed almost simultaneously, the roll is being executed and the stab will be automatically executed after the roll. A new option called [b]'Disabled Input Action Queue'[/b] was added, that disables the input action queue. If the queue is disabled an action executed during a roll will NOT be executed at the end of the roll.

[b]Future plans:[/b] For this year we still have two patches planned. Make sure to stay tuned!

Thank you for your feedback and patience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/32d5159ae885658938566182f2c9a11cc693dbb3.png[/img]

notes.title: Wigmund - Patch 1.4.0 Next Project & New Game⁺
notes.notes:
Hello!

[h3]Next Title[/h3]
We would be very interested in hearing your opinion about a potential future title. Feel free to drop in to our twitter page and vote in the next project poll.

[h3]Other News[/h3]
In other news, we announce our New Game Plus game mode. You will be able to save a character profile in-game and start a New Game Plus. The 'Impossible+' difficulty level has been tuned to serve the new mode, for those that would like a bit of a challenge. Now go and obliterate those pesky wolves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/6ad64b60183e1adc2aba0f80242aa81f6a7faefc.gif[/img]

[b][b]NG+ Features:[/b][/b]
[list]
[*]If the 'Secret Door' quest is completed, the 'Platinum Box' is kept
[*]If the 'Platinum Box' is owned a stash is added to Wigmund's house
[*]The 'Platinum' is usable only after the objective to meet Raedan is reached
[*]The Magnifying Glass is kept
[*]The Visibility Tablet is kept
[*]The Archaeology Shovel is kept
[*]All quest items are destroyed
[*]The tutorial is not displayed on NG+
[/list]

[b][b]Misc:[/b][/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the resource count (+ added extra spawn points)
[*]Added an action bar lock in options (items are not removable, only replaceable)
[*]Right-Click will be used to sell/store items when a merchant/stash is visible
[*]Recipes/Blueprints can be sold now
[*]Fixed a rare bug in which a fished casket would reward one less item
[*]Fixed an issue in which workbenches were not focus-able on the controller
[*]Fixed an issue when the elevator would not be accessible in the Haunted Basement after a Teleport
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and patience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/32d5159ae885658938566182f2c9a11cc693dbb3.png[/img]

notes.title: Wigmund - Patch 1.1.0 Archery, Talents and Professions
notes.notes:
Hello! 

We gladly announce the release of our new patch 1.1.0. It includes crafting & professions, talents (or perks), new abilities and a new Archer build, featuring ranged combat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/128ed8e86bccd77aa00a01cbd7cea38bf936a050.png[/img]

[b]Professions:[/b]
We have included three professions: Medicine, Crafting and Survival. With Medicine one will be able to craft potions for healing and elixirs that will increase stats for a longer duration. Collecting herbs will play a crucial role in this profession. 

With Crafting one can create some auxiliary armor pieces, item upgrades and jewels for enhancing items and weapons. Collecting animal hides and mining will be very important in crafting. 

And finally with Survival one will be able to fish, hunt and create different gastronomic experiences. And yes... with the proper dwarven fishing pole, one might even fish some treasure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/432877c5c8f6617ec238994299a73c380953d2ae.gif[/img]

[b]Talents:[/b]
We have added perks with four specializations: two handed sword ("Sword"), sword & shield ("Shield"), bow ("Ranger") and Exorcist for a melee-caster type of build. Vendors will provide re-specialization runes that will reset all points invested in any talents and attributes for a quick in-game re-specialization for players that would like to try out more than one build.

[b]Archery:[/b]
The archery build has made it into Wigmund! It offers the opportunity to engage enemies form a safe(r) distance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/55bc035660236d1f9176a6d41b5224bb09bc440b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/84716c64a6ff46fa4b070ae424e473d3eff01aa7.png[/img]

We have added two new equipment slots: belt and wrists. And for existing slots we've added some upgrades. Armor kits for helm, plate, legs and enchanted gems for armguards, wrists and belts.

With archery, of course bows also made their way into the game. Some with more emphasis on range, others on damage they will provide a new build opportunity for players less willing to engage in frontal combat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/60b68f8f98925f020f5c616c8a3f8e52b424a4a9.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/7141e0fdc6b8ce65ecf564f6f755530029f522d3.png[/img]

Some new abilities to reflect the Talent/Perk system have been also added. They include (but are not limited to): a holy shield for Exorcists, a Dagger Storm for Rangers and a Shield Wall for Sword & Shield warriors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/08f39c9aaaa5eda03442bd879dc5ebbe566aa36d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/f9e0489114024f5457ff50006456c8be96a5ea85.png[/img]

A player stash is also available, along with the possibility to always teleport in the main map using the Platinum Box.

Improvements & fixes:
[list]
[*] Sprint toggling
[*] Minimap North locking
[*] Monitor selection
[*] User Interface Scale
[*] Fixes (too many to count)
[*] Old save file deletion, since the new content required it
[/list]

We would like to emphasize that all the new content, while it can enhance your capability in combat, is entirely optional and the game can be played as it was before.

We invite you to enter Wigmund's world! 

© 2022 The Scholastics / Wigmund. The Return of the Hidden Knights

notes.title: Wigmund - Release
notes.notes:
Hello! 

We announce the release of our full game! The five Chapters of the story are now fully available. This is the final content update. There are over 20 hours of content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/237e5f3e78c745abf8bb5f27856d06ed1e851793.png[/img]

The content includes twelve locations to visit:
[list]
[*] The Hidden Valley
[*] The Wolves Den
[*] Frod Forest - The Open World part
[*] Dracca's Caverns
[*] The Old Iron Mine
[*] The Fort's Dungeon
[*] The Bear's Den
[*] The Goblin's Caverns
[*] Ashdown Castle's Dungeon
[*] Ashdown Castle
[*] The Evil Castle
[*] Burning Heol
[/list]
The open-world maps will feature a full day/night cycle! That is because some quests require night time. Ghost stories are better told in the dark...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/6918e5cc79248f02778eb60563ac6bb1c5d93b03.gif[/img]

Not all the maps are related to the main quest, and you will have the opportunity to also explore secondary dungeons and caverns:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/2acbc14a6ac0c3d0cbace56bdee9c6e226beeeab.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/869ec246a31aa1726e1b3098855c5b08441ffa79.gif[/img]

And deep, terrifying dungeons:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/094fe574f924a14ea1c4cbb723ee62317e3671d3.gif[/img]

You can solve 15 main quests and also 18 secondary quests:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/d81adf340e380e319d26f8a49723a952b2d9909f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/84716c64a6ff46fa4b070ae424e473d3eff01aa7.png[/img]


There are a lot of equipment pieces, including (but not limited to) 9 armor sets, many swords, axes, hammers, shields, artifacts and everything else that a RPG should have:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/9b4a9b21308d57d6dcfa550eee7c2834e9225289.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/7434132465f2d18218325cc1cd447200527542bf.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/128ed8e86bccd77aa00a01cbd7cea38bf936a050.png[/img]

Many enemies will also provide unique and tough challenges for your hero. They will include:
[list]
[*] Trolls
[*] Whelps
[*] Ghosts
[*] Specters
[*] Wizards
[*] Elementals
[*] Imps
[*] Beasts
[*] Werewolves
[/list]
Oh yes, and a few dragon encounters. We have warned you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/380ebe76fca3051195e96609b88dc3a3bfa7030c.gif[/img]

We thank you for your patience, and we invite you to enter Wigmund's world! 

© 2022 The Scholastics / Wigmund. The Return of the Hidden Knights

notes.title: Wigmund - Major Gameplay Patch
notes.notes:
Hello,

Following the gameplay feedback we're made a major overhaul of it following a more usual keyboard+mouse control scheme:
[olist]
[*] 'WASD' is used now for movement
[*] Simple Left Mouse Click is used for attack
[*] Swipe attacks do not require 'CTRL' now. Note, they are optional, one can only use the simple attack
[*] A point & click movement mode can be used if one holds down the 'CTRL' key (but it's optional)
[*] Rolling is based on a simple key and a movement direction and are rebind-able
[*] Blocking/parrying are default on the Right Mouse Button and are rebind-able
[/olist]
We've also fixed some cloth related crashes that affected some users and are well under way with integrating an automatic crash report solution.

For the next week we will iron out all the bugs and issues and once we reach a stable version continue with releasing more content, hopefully releasing the full game this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/4ddea904f6761065ba3356e5fdaea0ecf2860125.png[/img]
